1842 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
299 days before 1842-11-29:  
Step back 29 days → 1842-10-31.  
Remaining 270 days: go back 9 months (Jan–Sep have 273 days in total for non-leap year).  
270 days earlier from Oct 31: Oct has 31 days, so Oct 31 → Sep 30 (1 day), then back through Sep (30 days) → Aug 31 (31 days) etc.  
Better: 299 days = 9 months + 27 days roughly? Let’s compute exactly:  

From 1842-11-29:  
Back 29 days → 1842-10-31.  
Back 270 more days:  
Oct: 31 days (already at Oct 31, so count from Oct 1 to Oct 31 as 30 days earlier? Let’s do direct subtraction from 1842-10-31):  

1842-10-31 minus 270 days:  
Go to 1842-01-31 is 273 days earlier (Jan 31 to Oct 31 = 273 days in non-leap year: Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31 → sum = 273).  
We need 270 days earlier, which is 3 days later than Jan 31: so 1842-02-03.  

Check: 1842-02-03 to 1842-11-29:  
Feb 1842: 25 days (from Feb 3 to Feb 28)  
Mar: 31, Apr: 30, May: 31, Jun: 30, Jul: 31, Aug: 31, Sep: 30, Oct: 31, Nov: 29.  
Sum = 25+31+30+31+30+31+31+30+31+29 = 299 days. Correct.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1842-02-03
